description: Source code for the RecipeKeeper class, which handles importing recipes from HTML files, parsing ingredients, steps, and images, and creating database objects in a Django project.

classes.name: RecipeKeeper
classes.description: A class that extends Integration to handle importing recipes from HTML files, parsing their content, and creating corresponding database entries.

methods.description: Parses a BeautifulSoup object representing a recipe HTML segment, creates Recipe, Step, Ingredient objects, and imports images.
